!!! FREELANCE AUTOMATION CONSULTANT GESUCHT !!!

hi zusammen, for our client, a fast growing e-commerce brand (Home & Living, ca 80 Mitarbeiter, Shopify Plus, Sitz Wien) we are looking for an automation expert ASAP.

what you do:
- build and maintain Workfows in n8n and/or Make (client has both, will be consolidated to n8n in Q1)
- integrations Shopify <-> Pipedrive <-> Xentral <-> Slack
- AI agents for support tickets (Zendesk) + product descriptions with GPT, DE/EN/IT
- JS code nodes, webhooks, error handling, monitoring, retry logic
- dokumentation + handover to inhouse team (2 ppl, junior)

MUST HAVE:
n8n, Make, REST API, JSON, JavaScript, webhooks, OpenAI API, prompt engineering, Shopify
NICE TO HAVE:
Airtable, Python, Zapier, HubSpot, Klaviyo

KEYWORDS: n8n | make.com | integromat | zapier | automation | workflow automatisierung | KI agenten | AI | LLM | GPT | e-commerce | shopify | pipedrive | xentral | API | no-code | low-code

start: ASAP / ab sofort
dauer: 3 monate mit option auf verlängerung
auslastung: 3-4 tage/woche
remote 100%, team sitzt in wien, onsite NICHT nötig
